subject: GCP Marketplace redemption sprint + co-sell handshake
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Anna Li <anna.li@gcp-partner.google.com>, Michael Torres <michael.torres@acmeops.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-31T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: GCP Marketplace redemption sprint + co-sell handshake

Hi Anna and Michael,

Thanks again for moving quickly on the private offer. We want to lock a short, disciplined "redemption sprint" to make sure the committed SKUs are consumed by the end of Q3 and hand the customer to your co-sell team without friction. Proposed high-level plan (attached: redemption-plan-v1.pdf):

- 6-week sprint starting 2027-06-10: weekly burn checkpoints and one escalation window on week 4.
- Primary SKUs to shepherd: rdw.inference.dedicated, rdw.storage.snapshots (see attached spreadsheet).
- Invoicing cadence: Redwood invoices monthly; want to align GCP private-offer drawdown dates to avoid double-billing in July.
- Co-sell handoff: schedule a 30-minute handshake meeting one week before the sprint starts.

Action items for Ghroups:
- Anna: confirm GCP private-offer start date and whether drawdown can be frontloaded for the first invoice period.
- Michael: confirm internal ramp schedule and any blackout dates for heavy usage.
- Marissa/Ben/Laura (cc'd): prep the SKU consumption map and run-rate caps.

If we align on these items this week, we can share a one-page mutual action plan with legal and procurement afterwards.

Thanks,

Jordan Blake
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redemption-plan-v1.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

From: Anna Li <anna.li@gcp-partner.google.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: gcp-co-sell@google.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Michael Torres <michael.torres@acmeops.com>
Date: 2027-05-31T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace redemption sprint + co-sell handshake

Jordan — thanks for the clear plan and the attachment. Happy to support the sprint. A few notes from the GCP side:

- We can schedule the co-sell handshake with our AMs. gcp-co-sell@google.com is cc'd to coordinate calendar availability.
- Private offer start: GCP can support a start window the week of 2027-06-10; we need that final commitment by 2027-06-07 to get billing aligned.
- Drawdown behavior: we typically let partners choose frontload vs. linear drawdown; frontloading for the first invoice period is feasible but requires us to document the preferred burn schedule in the private-offer record.
- We'll need a single point of contact for weekly consumption reports (can be Marissa). Also: provide the SKU mapping and per-SKU QPS assumptions so we can validate quotas.

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Anna Li <anna.li@gcp-partner.google.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Michael Torres <michael.torres@acmeops.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-01T08:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace redemption sprint + co-sell handshake

Anna — great, appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple of operational clarifications from ops/finance:

- Invoice alignment: Redwood will invoice monthly on the 1st. For June/July we want the GCP drawdown to reflect realized consumption by calendar month to avoid customers seeing two overlapping charges. If GCP can accept a June 10 start with drawdown recorded on June 30, that will match our billing.
- Frontload tradeoffs: frontloading the private-offer into the first invoice period is helpful for customers who want immediate credits; if we do that, we should put an explicit burn ladder in the private-offer metadata so GCP can mark redemption accordingly.
- Quotas & soft-limits: Laura and I will provide per-SKU soft-limits and a canary window (first 72 hours) where we throttle to 70% to validate stability. See attached slides for the handshake meeting deck (co-sell-handshake-slides.pptx).

Proposed meeting times for handshake (30 minutes):
- 2027-06-03 10:00 PT
- 2027-06-03 15:00 PT
- 2027-06-06 09:00 PT

Please pick one and we'll send a calendar invite with the agenda + invite the GCP AMs.

Ben Carter
Finance Ops, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachment: co-sell-handshake-slides.pptx (PPTX, 2.8MB)

Thanks everyone — this looks good. Confirming AcmeOps can start the internal ramp the week of 2027-06-10. We prefer the June 3 10:00 PT handshake; Michael (me) will be there with our SRE and procurement lead.

Two quick asks:
1) Can Redwood share the 72-hour canary throttling thresholds in the meeting notes?
2) We'll need the DocuSign private-offer acceptance link by 2027-06-07 to finalize the billing window.

I'll register for the calendar invite once it's sent.

—Michael
Michael Torres
Head of Cloud Operations, AcmeOps
michael.torres@acmeops.com
